title: 武士机甲女孩参考表
author: てんねん
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,游戏素材,草图 / 线稿,动漫 / 漫画,角色,图解 / 图表
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a clean anime concept art reference sheet for a Samurai Mecha Girl, combining a school-uniform samurai heroine with exposed light-mecha prosthetic limbs, presented as high-resolution monochrome production-design line art with small technical notes.

Canvas: Vertical portrait character sheet, off-white paper background, thin black outer border, 3:4 aspect ratio. Use crisp black and gray pencil/ink linework, minimal shading, no full color except a small color guide. The overall look is a Japanese setting-materials sheet, precise and highly detailed.

Layout: Top-left large English title “Samurai Mecha Girl” with smaller Japanese subtitle “侍機巧娘” below it. The left and center two-thirds contain the main full-body character illustration. The right third is a boxed head-turnaround panel. The bottom area contains weapon and mechanical-part diagrams. Keep the page airy, technical, and neatly ruled with thin divider lines.

Main subject: A 17-year-old anime girl with short straight bob hair with blunt bangs, serious eyes, and circular mechanical ear/head sensor modules. She wears a sailor-style school uniform with scarf, short pleated skirt, thigh-high stockings, and mechanical armor integrated into one arm and one leg. Pose her kneeling dynamically: one knee down, one cybernetic leg raised, torso angled forward, one mechanical hand braced near the ground, and the other hand holding a katana horizontally above her head. The katana has a wrapped handle and a long slightly curved blade. Her mecha limbs are detailed with pistons, circular joints, armor plates, cables, segmented fingers, and heavy boot components.

Visible text and labeled sections: Include exactly 7 major text/detail blocks: 1) top-left title block with “Samurai Mecha Girl” and “侍機巧娘”; 2) a stats box listing “TYPE : ASSAULT”, “CLASS : LIGHT MECHA”, “HEIGHT : 158cm”, “WEIGHT : 49kg”, “AGE : 17”, “AFFILIATION : UNKNOWN”; 3) a “CONCEPT” block with short Japanese paragraph lines; 4) a “SPEC” block with Japanese bullet points; 5) a bottom weapon section labeled “武装” and “ENERGY KATANA / エネルギー式刀剣”; 6) a bottom mechanical parts section labeled “ARM UNIT / 腕部ユニット” and “LEG UNIT / 脚部ユニット”; 7) a right-side lower notes area with “COLOR GUIDE（参考）” and “DETAIL”.

Right-side head turnaround panel: Add one bordered panel titled “頭部ラフスケッチ三面図”. Inside it, show exactly 3 head drawings stacked vertically and labeled “FRONT”, “SIDE”, and “BACK”: front view with face and headband, side profile showing the circular ear mechanism, and back view showing the bob haircut and rear of the mechanical module.

Bottom diagrams: In the weapon box, show exactly 1 horizontal energy katana diagram with a wrapped grip. In the mechanical parts box, show exactly 5 separate component drawings: two arm-unit views on the left and three leg-unit views on the right, each rendered as detailed mechanical line-art studies.

Color guide: Include exactly 6 small square swatches with labels: main armor dark iron, sub armor white gray, accent red, mechanical joints gold, cloth dark blue, hair brown, plus a small orange eye/accent swatch if needed; keep these as the only colored elements on the page.

Style constraints: Use refined monochrome anime drafting, thin clean outlines, technical callout-sheet composition, high-detail mechanical design, subtle paper texture, sharp readable typography, no background scenery, no dramatic lighting, no painterly rendering, no extra characters.\

The car drifts on a glossy white reflective studio-like floor that maintains soft reflections and realistic shadows, enhanced with light drift skid reflections and directional smudges.

Under that, a short descriptive paragraph about the car’s character (efficiency, style, reliability).
Bottom section shows a clean grid layout of specifications. If real specs are known from the detected car model, generate accurate values; if not, generate placeholders in the same layout style (4 columns: horsepower, 0–100 km/h, top speed, engine displacement/fuel type).

prompt_en: Create a cinematic post-apocalyptic science-fiction scene in a misty industrial wetland. The canvas is a square 1:1 image with muted gray-green color grading, soft overcast daylight, shallow atmospheric haze, and highly detailed photorealistic textures. Show exactly 4 human figures: 1 tall foreground traveler on the left walking through the moss, wearing a hooded, layered, mud-stained long coat, wrapped boots, gloves, a large sagging backpack, straps, dangling canisters, and a slung rifle or long tool; 1 kneeling technician on the right working with both hands on the valves of a huge cylindrical machine; 1 distant standing figure in the far left background; and 1 small crouched figure near the center background. Make all faces indistinct, shadowed, or softly blurred, with no clear facial features. The ground is a dense carpet of bright green moss mounds broken by shallow puddles and narrow reflective streams. On the right, place a massive dark metal cylindrical tank covered in moss, grime, rivets, gauges, circular hatches, pipes, and leaking water; in the background include exactly 5 visible major industrial towers or tanks, softened by fog and depth of field. Water should drip and cascade from machinery surfaces, with wet metal highlights and moss growing over platforms and pipes. The mood should be quiet, eerie, and exploratory, like survivors maintaining ancient machinery in a reclaimed industrial ruin. Use moss-covered industrial wetland, hooded layered mud-stained long coat with backpack and canisters, huge cylindrical tanks with valves, pipes, gauges, and leaks, desaturated gray-green with damp black metal, and foggy overcast cinematic post-apocalyptic realism. Avoid readable text, logos, clean modern clothing, bright sunlight, fantasy armor, or extra people.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical travel poster illustration of Budapest, Hungary as an intricate handmade paper-cut diorama, showing historic architecture, the Danube River, and timeless streets in a warm nostalgic style.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 composition, like a detailed editorial travel cover. Use a soft textured blue paper sky background with subtle grain, warm afternoon light, and layered cut-paper shadows that make every building, tree, bridge, cloud, and rooftop feel physically assembled from paper.

Layout: Use an elevated viewpoint from the Buda hills looking down over the city. The foreground is a steep cobblestone street with tram tracks, a yellow vintage tram, pedestrians, bicycles, old stone walls, potted café plants, and red-tiled rooftops. The middle ground contains Buda Castle and Fisherman's Bastion on the left, the Danube River running diagonally through the center, Chain Bridge crossing the river to the right, and the Hungarian Parliament building on the far right riverbank. The background shows a distant city skyline, low blue hills, and atmospheric haze.

Text content: Add a large handwritten white chalk-script title in the upper right reading Budapest. Include exactly 5 small white handwritten landmark annotations with delicate arrows and doodles: “Fisherman's Bastion” pointing to the towers on the upper left, “Matthias Church” pointing to the ornate church roof and spire, “Buda Castle” pointing to the domed palace, “Parliament” pointing to the riverside parliament building with a small heart doodle, and “Chain Bridge” pointing to the suspension bridge with a tiny bridge sketch. Add a few tiny decorative stars, a dotted travel path, and a small location-pin doodle near the title.

Visible elements to include: exactly 2 cream paper clouds in the sky, one larger cloud at upper left and one smaller cloud below it near the center; exactly 2 simple bird silhouettes over the river/sky; exactly 1 yellow tram marked with the number “2”; exactly 1 white river boat on the lower right of the Danube; exactly 1 café terrace in the lower right with round tables, chairs, umbrellas, and flower pots; exactly 2 bicycles near the lower center; several layered trees made from muted green paper cutouts.

Visual style: Highly detailed paper-cut collage, miniature diorama depth, realistic architectural silhouettes but softened by handmade craft texture. Color palette of dusty teal sky, cream paper highlights, terracotta roofs, muted sage trees, beige stone buildings, turquoise-blue river, and golden-yellow tram. Use soft shadows under every cut-paper layer, slight edge roughness, tactile paper fibers, and no photorealistic people.

Constraints: Keep the scene charming and dense but readable, preserve the historic Budapest landmarks accurately enough to recognize them, avoid modern billboards or cars, avoid extra landmark labels beyond the 5 listed annotations, and do not add watermarks or logos.\

prompt_en: Create a dreamy vertical zodiac-inspired character poster based on the soft emotional world and cozy slice-of-life aesthetic of Yumi’s Cells, reimagined through a strong Taurus personality theme. Keep the subject’s real face completely untouched and natural. Surround the subject with several adorable mini 3D chibi “cell” versions of themselves, glossy, expressive, slightly raw and realistic, with oversized heads and tiny detailed bodies inspired by Korean-style character design. Each mini Taurus cell should embody a different mood or trait: one hugging the subject’s arm possessively, one wrapped in a fluffy blanket, one calmly reading a book, one sipping warm coffee or tea, one obsessed with desserts or snacks, one lazily scrolling on a phone while lying down, one stubbornly refusing to get up, one sleepy and emotionally unbothered, and one with messy “just woke up” energy. Their expressions should feel playful, comforting, cozy, and emotionally relatable. Include hand-drawn doodle-style elements integrated naturally into the composition — soft sketch outlines around poses, tiny flowers, sparkles, steam swirls from drinks, fluffy cushions, floating symbols, relaxed motion accents, and whimsical notes that interact with both the subject and the mini cells. The overall design should feel warm, aesthetic, and emotionally intimate with clean layout balance, white sticker-style borders, glossy high-detail 3D chibi rendering, and a cozy Korean editorial poster vibe. Use a harmonious palette of sage green, warm cream, dusty pink, beige, soft brown, and muted earthy tones. Blend luxury-loving comfort energy with calm softness and subtle humor so the identity is deeply felt throughout the entire artwork.\

title: BMW M4 GT4 赛车运动海报
author: ᴍᴜʀᴘʜʏ
categories: 海报 / 传单,产品营销,电影感 / 电影剧照,摄影,交通工具,文字 / 排版,图解 / 图表
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dramatic vertical motorsport advertising poster for BMW M4 GT4, styled like a premium race-car launch campaign.

Canvas: Tall 2:3 portrait poster, dark cinematic lighting, black background with deep red smoke, glossy wet asphalt reflections, high contrast, sharp commercial automotive photography mixed with graphic-design overlays.

Main subject: A white BMW M4 GT4 race car viewed from a low front three-quarter angle, positioned slightly right of center. The car has aggressive GT bodywork, wide stance, large black kidney grille, glowing cool-white LED headlights, black front splitter, black wheels, rear wing, roll cage visible through the windshield, and blue/red BMW M Motorsport racing stripes across the hood and sides. Add dirt, scratches, race wear, and water droplets for realism. The car sits on a wet reflective track surface with red and blue light reflections.

Background and atmosphere: Huge dark red transparent letters spelling BMW fill the upper background behind the car. Add red smoke or tire haze rising behind the vehicle. Include faint technical blueprint line art of the car on the left side behind the main car. Add thin grid lines, measurement marks, and subtle HUD-style interface details.

Layout and graphic elements: Use exactly 4 blue corner bracket markers: one at the top-left, one at the top-right, one at the bottom-left, and one at the bottom-right. At the top-left, add small spaced text reading “BMW M MOTORSPORT” with a tiny blue square marker. Along the right edge, add vertical small text reading “MOTORSPORT · TRACK-SPEC · CERTIFIED”.

Left technical spec block: Add exactly 5 stacked specs with red arrow markers and small white labels: 1) ENGINE — 3.0L I6, 2) POWER — 503 HP, 3) TORQUE — 600 NM, 4) WEIGHT — <1,600 KG, 5) DRIVE — RWD.

Bottom title block: Above the main title, add small spaced text “THE BEAMER”. Large title below: “M4” with the M letter in blue, purple, and red motorsport colors and the 4 in white. Under it, add “GT4” in italic metallic silver. At the bottom center, add exactly 4 feature callouts separated by thin red vertical dividers: 1) 503 / POWER, 2) TWIN / TURBO, 3) RWD / DRIVE, 4) TRACK / FOCUS. Bottom-left microcopy: “BUILT FOR PERFORMANCE. BORN ON THE TRACK.” Bottom-right: small BMW M tri-color logo mark.

Visual style: Premium editorial car poster, glossy black-and-red color grade, neon red rim light, blue accent light, realistic reflections, crisp typography, subtle film grain, vignette, cyber-technical motorsport aesthetic, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, high-end commercial advertising finish.

Constraints: Keep all text clean and legible, no extra cars, no people, no watermark, no random logos beyond BMW M-style branding, maintain the exact counted text/spec elements and corner markers.\

The central subject is Dilshad Hussain, full body from head to thighs, facing forward, one hand lifted to an earpiece near his ear, wearing a glossy gradient bomber jacket in cyan, lavender, and pink over a black shirt, with taupe cargo pants and black cuffs. Use realistic 3D character proportions and cinematic lighting; keep the face centered and realistic, or use an uploaded facial reference if provided. The studio is a circular high-tech room with curved cyan LED dot-matrix walls, transparent glass panels, magenta neon trim, a glowing pink circular ceiling ring, smoky atmosphere, reflective dark floor, and strong blue-pink rim lighting. Add large floating neon typography across the lower center in two lines: the first line says Dilshad Hussain in bright cyan outlined glow, and the second line says Ai influencer in hot pink neon glow, angled slightly across the subject. Surround him with exactly 10 floating social media UI elements: 1 Instagram app logo near the upper right, 1 follower count speech bubble reading 24.3K near the upper right chest area, 4 pink heart notification bubbles placed left middle, right middle, bottom right, and a large blurred foreground one at bottom left, and 4 Reels/play icons placed upper left, lower left, bottom left, and lower right. Include a subtle futuristic holographic HUD panel glowing on the subject’s chest. Make the image vibrant, glossy, premium, high contrast, depth-of-field, volumetric haze, and suitable for a social media promotion poster. Avoid extra text, avoid watermarks, and keep the composition centered and dramatic.\

– children in festive clothes running happily in background
– elegant Eid market sellers smiling naturally
